methodology.fundamentalBasis: Latest available full-year net income and year-end equity, applied 90 days after fiscal year-end to avoid look-ahead bias.
methodology.portfolioAggregation: Daily market-value weighted harmonic P/E and P/BV, equivalent to total position value divided by attributable earnings or book value.
methodology.updateCadence: Scheduled after the Indonesia Stock Exchange close on trading weekdays.
methodology.caveat: Market data may be delayed. Annual-basis ratios are not trailing-twelve-month ratios.
